name: Sukusuku School Mizugi
original_name: すくすくスクール水着
source:
This is a fully voiced CG novel in which the player takes on the role of the swimming club advisor and violates two female students. 

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180707060201/http://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ007887.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
这是一部全配音CG小说，玩家扮演游泳社顾问，对两名女学生进行侵犯。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180707060201/http://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ007887.html]DLsite[/url]]
